title: Retrieved craft revealed unknown propulsion

tellings.quote: In one way we have learned that some types of propulsion for example exist that we did never never envisioned never conceived.

plain: Studying recovered craft taught the US that kinds of propulsion exist that no one had ever imagined. That is how Harold Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents, puts it, pointing to the account of Philip J. Corso, an Army officer who wrote about handling such material: "some types of propulsion for example exist that we did never, never envision." If true, it would mean the craft gave the country a real leap in technology.
